newsitem.title: USA: Williams Cos comfortable with estimates.
newsitem.headline: Williams Cos comfortable with estimates.

text.p: Williams Cos Chairman Keith Bailey on Monday said he was comfortable with analysts' estimates of $2.27 to $2.57 a share earnings in 1997.

Normal growth would push its earnings past the lower end of the analysts' estimates, and acquisitions accretive to earnings could propel the company into the upper end of the range, he said at the annual Howard Weil energy conference here. "All of those are things that we are working hard to do and we continue to be optimistic," he said.
The company has pegged stock bonus plans for its employees to meeting the range of analysts' estimates, he said.
